events.name: FILE_SELECT
events.description: Called when a file is clicked

events.name: NODE_EXPAND
events.description: Called the first time a node marked `expandable` is expanded, with its path, so its children can be loaded.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-busy
overridableConfigKeys.description: This region is updating; assistive technology waits before announcing it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-current
overridableConfigKeys.description: Marks the current item in a set: the current page, step, location, date or time.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-describedby
overridableConfigKeys.description: Id of the element whose text describes this one (help text, error).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-expanded
overridableConfigKeys.description: Whether the element it controls is expanded.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-hidden
overridableConfigKeys.description: Hide from assistive technology (decorative content only).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Accessible name read by screen readers when the visible text is missing or not descriptive (e.g. an icon-only control).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-labelledby
overridableConfigKeys.description: Id of the element whose text names this one.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-live
overridableConfigKeys.description: Announce changes to this region: polite waits for a pause, assertive interrupts.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-pressed
overridableConfigKeys.description: Toggle-button state.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-selected
overridableConfigKeys.description: Whether this item is selected (tabs, options, grid cells).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Class Name
overridableConfigKeys.description: CSS class

overridableConfigKeys.label: Dir
overridableConfigKeys.description: Text direction of this element's content.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Enter
overridableConfigKeys.description: How this element animates in when it mounts (theme-styled); overrides the theme's default slot entry. `none` opts out.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Enter Delay
overridableConfigKeys.description: Stagger step for the entry: waits this many `--motion-enter-stagger` steps before animating.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Expanded Paths
overridableConfigKeys.description: Paths to show expanded (e.g. to reveal a node): each is expanded when it appears here, loading its children if needed.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Indent
overridableConfigKeys.description: Indent size per level in px (default: 16)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Items
overridableConfigKeys.description: Flat node list, nested by `parentId` at render time — takes precedence over `tree` when provided. A `parentId` with no matching row renders that node as a root rather than dropping it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Lang
overridableConfigKeys.description: Language of this element's content (BCP 47, e.g. ar, sl, en).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Visual treatment for flat `items` mode: `files` (default) keeps the monospace file-browser look; `nav` renders a sidebar navigation tree — regular font, document icons, roomier hit areas.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Node Action Icon
overridableConfigKeys.description: Icon for the row hover action (default: plus).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Node Action Label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Accessible label/tooltip for the row hover action.

overridableConfigKeys.label: On File Select
overridableConfigKeys.description: Called when a file is clicked

overridableConfigKeys.label: On Node Action
overridableConfigKeys.description: Called from the row's hover action button, in flat `items` mode; carries that node's id. Presence-gated: binding it renders the action.

overridableConfigKeys.label: On Node Expand
overridableConfigKeys.description: Called the first time a node marked `expandable` is expanded, with its path, so its children can be loaded.

overridableConfigKeys.label: On Node Reorder
overridableConfigKeys.description: Called when a row is dropped onto another, in flat `items` mode; carries the moved node's id, its new parent id (`null` for a root drop), and its index within the new parent's children. Presence-gated: binding this prop is what turns on row dragging.

overridableConfigKeys.label: On Node Select
overridableConfigKeys.description: Called when a node is clicked, in flat `items` mode; carries the selected node's id. Presence-gated: binding this prop is what turns on the click-to-select affordance, mirroring Badge's `onRemove`.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Role
overridableConfigKeys.description: WAI-ARIA role when the element's native semantics don't describe it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Selected Id
overridableConfigKeys.description: Currently selected node id, in flat `items` mode: the row highlights and every ancestor auto-expands so the selection is always visible — the 'you are here' a navigation tree needs.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Selected Path
overridableConfigKeys.description: Currently selected file path

overridableConfigKeys.label: Skeleton
overridableConfigKeys.description: Skeleton shown while this element's server render is in flight: a shape (`table`, `list`, …), `{ variant, rows?, columns?, fields? }`, or `none`.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tab Index
overridableConfigKeys.description: 0 puts the element in the Tab order; -1 makes it focusable only programmatically.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tree
overridableConfigKeys.description: The tree data (pre-nested). Ignored when `items` is provided.
